name: Marching Cubes Boundary Cap
definition: A post-processing step for Marching Cubes (MC) that closes open mesh boundaries when the isosurface exits the sample-cube boundary. It solves the problem of non-watertight meshes (IsWatertight = false) caused by insufficient bounding ranges, ensuring the output is a closed 2-manifold suitable for 3D printing.
summary: Marching Cubes Boundary Cap is a post-processing step that seals open mesh boundaries at sample-cube faces using 2D Marching Squares, ensuring watertightness even with undersized bounding ranges.
